title: host-contract.json
description: Top-level keys allowed in host-contract.json. The host-readback gate (assets/host-readback/check_host_drift.py) derives its `known` set from this file's `properties` so the schema is the single source of truth (DysTelefonica/team-skills#946). Adding a key to the canon means editing this file; no code change needed in the gate.

host_capabilities.description: Capability declarations per area (HR-303), verified by the readback in both directions. Keys: branch_protection, rulesets, required_checks. `available` = the host can apply that area; `unavailable` = it cannot (a private repo without Pro answers the API with the plan 403). An absent capability is read as `available`, so declaring it stops the contract from promising by omission what the host does not apply.

labels.description: Label definitions with host-enforced / documented-only / runner-enforced classification (HR-15). `host-enforced` = the host holds the label in its catalog (`GET /labels`), which is what the drift check contrasts; the host does not demand the label at merge time, the CI does. `documented-only` = the host does not hold it or does not demand it. Labels exist on every plan, so their class does not depend on `host_capabilities`.

approvers.description: Deprecated (DysTelefonica/team-skills#1093, R1). Logins that may put `status:approved` on an issue. Since R1 the issue-spec gate does not read this list: `status:approved` is a convention that anyone (agents included) may apply and that no gate requires. The key is kept so the consumer contracts that declare it stay valid.

required_checks.description: Required check names with classification. `host-enforced` = the host DEMANDS that check (branch protection), and it is only admissible when `host_capabilities.required_checks` is `available`; with the capability `unavailable` the host cannot demand it and the honest class is `documented-only` (the CI runs the check, the host does not require it).

merge_methods.description: Merge method declarations (allow_merge_commit, allow_squash_merge, allow_rebase_merge, allow_update_branch, allow_auto_merge). Repository settings exist on every plan: `host-enforced` means the host shows that value, and it does not depend on `host_capabilities`.

protection.description: Repository protection declarations. `host-enforced` = the host applies that flag, and it is only admissible when `host_capabilities.branch_protection` is `available`; with the capability `unavailable` the host cannot protect the branch and the honest class is `documented-only`.

rulesets.description: Ruleset declarations with enforcement and classification. `host-enforced` = the host applies that ruleset, and it is only admissible when `host_capabilities.rulesets` is `available`; with the capability `unavailable` the host cannot apply rulesets and the honest class is `documented-only`.

runner.description: Runner label declaration used by the runner-enforced checks.

post_merge_dispatch.description: Optional. Basenames of workflows to redispatch via workflow_dispatch after a governed merge (DysTelefonica/team-skills#817, HR-817). Each basename must exist as a workflow with `on: workflow_dispatch:` in the repo; if not, the merge fails closed before PUT /merge.

governed_path.description: Optional. Exige que lo que llega a una rama protegida por contrato haya entrado por el camino gobernado (DysTelefonica/team-skills#909). Un PR mergeado en una rama protegida cumple si su `merged_by.login` esta en `actors` (ruta fuerte: la plataforma la firma) o si su commit de merge casa con `merge_marker` (ruta debil, corroboracion). Sin la clave, o con `enabled: false`, el veredicto del detective no cambia. Un contrato inservible falla cerrado con exit 2 (HR-3).

enabled.description: Optional, por defecto false. Activa la verificacion del camino de merge.

actors.description: Obligatoria con `enabled: true`. Logins de los fusionadores legitimos; un array vacio o con entradas no textuales hace fallar cerrado el contrato.

merge_marker.description: Opcional. Regex que debe casar con la primera linea del mensaje del commit de merge. Por defecto `^Merge PR #\d+ \(governed merge\)$`, la firma que emite el merge gobernado. Una regex que no compila hace fallar cerrado el contrato.

tracker_branch.description: Optional (DysTelefonica/team-skills#333, regla 7). Con la clave declarada, lo que llega a una rama protegida tiene que venir por el PR del tracker (modelo «rama de feature con PR tracker en borrador»). Sin declaracion el control no cambia: una cadena apilada hacia main no necesita tracker y exigirlo sin declararlo inventaria una regla que el contrato no pide. Una cadena vacia o no textual hace fallar cerrado el contrato (HR-3).
